sloka: मया रोषपरीतेन यदिदं व्याहृतं वचः ।नैतच्छक्यं वृथा कर्तुं प्रदास्यामि च ते वरम् ।। ७.६५.३५ ॥
transliteration: mayā roṣaparītena yadidaṁ vyāhṛtaṁ vacaḥ ।naitacchakyaṁ vṛthā kartuṁ pradāsyāmi ca te varam ।। 7.65.35 ॥

translations.english: The words I have spoken while overcome by anger cannot be made in vain, but I will grant you a boon.
